gitCommit.subject: fix(deps): patch security vulnerabilities in dependencies (#1411)
gitCommit.body:
fix(deps): patch security vulnerabilities in dependencies (#1411)

Bump axios (1.12.0→1.13.5), storybook (8.6.15→8.6.17), and add pnpm
overrides to force security patches for transitive deps: ajv (→6.14.0),
bn.js (→4.12.3), minimatch (→3.1.5), qs (→6.15.0), svgo (→3.3.3),
webpack (→5.105.4). Excludes Next.js 14→15 major bump which requires
dedicated migration.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
